description: This file contains utility functions and classes for implementing YOLO object detection, including processing network outputs, correcting bounding boxes, non-max suppression, image preprocessing, and drawing detection boxes on images. It appears to be part of a deprecated TensorFlow/Keras-based YOLO detection pipeline.

classes.name: BoundBox
classes.description: Represents a bounding box with coordinates, objectness score, class probabilities, and label information.

methods.name: yolo_head(feats, anchors, num_classes, input_shape, calc_loss=False)
methods.description: Processes raw network features to produce bounding box parameters, confidence scores, and class probabilities.

methods.name: yolo_correct_boxes(box_xy, box_wh, input_shape, image_shape)
methods.description: Adjusts bounding boxes to match the original image shape, accounting for letterboxing.

methods.name: yolo_boxes_and_scores(feats, anchors, num_classes, input_shape, image_shape)
methods.description: Calculates bounding boxes and their associated scores from network features.

methods.name: yolo_eval(yolo_outputs, anchors, num_classes, image_shape, max_boxes=20, score_threshold=.6, iou_threshold=.5)
methods.description: Performs evaluation of YOLO output tensors, including NMS and thresholding, to produce final detection boxes.

methods.name: letterbox_image(image, size)
methods.description: Resizes an input image with letterboxing to fit a target size while maintaining aspect ratio.

methods.name: correct_yolo_boxes(boxes, image_h, image_w, net_h, net_w)
methods.description: Further adjusts bounding boxes based on net and image dimensions.

methods.name: retrieve_yolo_detections(yolo_result, anchors, min_probability, nms_thresh, image_input_size, image_size, labels_dict )
methods.description: Processes raw YOLO network outputs to retrieve detections with labels and probabilities.

methods.name: draw_boxes(image, box_points, draw_box, label, percentage_probability, color)
methods.description: Draws bounding boxes and labels onto an image.

methods.name: preprocess_input(image, input_shape)
methods.description: Preprocesses an image for input into the YOLO network, including resizing and normalization.

methods.name: decode_netout(netout, anchors, obj_thresh, nms_thresh, net_h, net_w)
methods.description: Decodes YOLO neural network raw output into bounding boxes.

methods.name: bbox_iou(box1, box2)
methods.description: Calculates the Intersection over Union (IoU) between two bounding boxes.

methods.name: do_nms(boxes, nms_thresh)
methods.description: Applies Non-Max Suppression to filter overlapping bounding boxes based on IoU threshold.
